meta.title: Dementia mother's will
meta.anchorTruth: The 60:40 notarized copy remained that ratio from the beginning, but a separate handwritten practice copy, old account flows, and mother's diary re-establish the context of the will change.
meta.emotionalBait: Yoon Tae-seong, who had been disapproving of his younger brother all his life, breaks down when he sees that his share is 40 percent in the will left by his mother with dementia. My younger brother remains calm until the end. So it looks more suspicious.
meta.resolutionDilemma: The responsibility for tampering with the will, the mother's ability to make decisions, and the long-standing burden hidden between the siblings must be judged together.
meta.triggerAmplifier: At first, the suicide note rate and nursing home visit records seem like Yoon Jeong-hoo's intervention. However, when notary notes, handwritten practice books, old account flows, and mother's diary are opened one after another, the case goes beyond a simple inheritance dispute.

partyA.name: Taeseong Yoon
partyA.speechStyle: He raises his voice to suppress others and asserts his position as the older brother first. When things get at a disadvantage, he tries to neutralize the question itself by belittling his younger brother's character.
partyA.fear: The collapse of my identity, which I believed my whole life as the eldest son — that's what I'm afraid of.
partyA.dailyRoutine: He processed orders at the factory and visited his mother's house in the evenings, maintaining a lifestyle that he said he took care of.
sensitivePoints: Factory crisis and 300 million won support history

verbalTells.pattern: When things get at a disadvantage, he turns the issue around by citing his seniority, saying, “I lived with my older brother.”
He first tries to undermine the other person's trust by bringing up his younger brother's personality or past.
When emotions arise, the voice becomes louder, making it difficult for the other person to continue speaking.

partyB.name: Yoon Jeong-hoo
partyB.speechStyle: Suppress your emotions as much as possible and only state the facts briefly. It looks calm, but that calmness actually raises suspicion. I try not to reveal my true feelings until the end.
partyB.fear: My brother finding out my birth secret — that's scary.
partyB.dailyRoutine: While running the store, he sent money to his mother whenever he had time, and helped pay regular subsidies and hospital expenses without his brother's knowledge.

verbalTells.pattern: When asked key questions, narrow down your answers and be defensive without showing any emotion.
They choose silence over lies, and hide the truth by not speaking.
The first thing that leaks out is that he did it because he was afraid the other person would collapse.

relationshipLedger.description: As to who my mother cared for more when she was alive, the memories of the two brothers are completely opposite.
relationshipLedger.distortionDirection: Yoon Tae-seong remembers that he should receive more since he took care of it, and Yoon Jeong-hu does not tell her, knowing that his mother originally intended to leave 90 to him.

relationshipLedger.description: Yoon Tae-seong has no idea about the regular support money that Jeong-hoo Yoon sent to his mother's bank account for a long time, and the 300 million won that was transferred through Tae-seong Yoon's mother's bank account during the factory crisis.
Yoon Tae-seong's birth secret - only B knows that he is not his father's biological son.
Both sides know that the will was changed 60:40. However, Taeseong Yoon does not yet know the exact ratio of separate handwritten practice books.
relationshipLedger.distortionDirection: Yoon Tae-seong concludes that the 60:40 ratio is the result of Yoon Jeong-hoo increasing his share.

context.description: In the will left by the mother with dementia, it is written that the younger brother is 60% and the older brother 40%. Yoon Tae-seong, who prides himself on having lived his entire life taking care of his mother, becomes angry, while his younger brother remains calm until the end.
context.triggerAmplifier: At first, the suicide note rate and nursing home visit records seem like Yoon Jeong-hoo's intervention. However, when notary notes, handwritten practice books, old account flows, and mother's diary are opened one after another, the case goes beyond a simple inheritance dispute.

disputes.name: Will writing and judgment skills
disputes.truthDescription: Yoon Jeong-hoo visited his mother frequently during her last years and discussed the contents of her will. Although the replacement of the caregiver overlapped with the time of notarization, the mother's wishes were not completely ignored.
disputes.mediationLink: Legality of the process of writing a will in later life
disputes.judgmentStatement: Although the mother's ability to make decisions was not completely lost, Yoon Jeong-hoo's intervention leaves questions of legality.

verdictOptions.wrong: The mother wrote the will under pressure from her younger brother, and was in a state where she was unable to make a proper decision.
verdictOptions.partial: Although there are questions about the mother's cognitive ability, it is difficult to conclude that it is completely invalid.
verdictOptions.truth: In his later years, Yoon Jeong-hu visited frequently and discussed her will, but he did not completely ignore his mother's wishes.
verdictOptions.defer: It is impossible to confirm whether the mother has the ability to make judgments. I reserve it.

disputes.name: Difference between a notarized will and a separate document
disputes.truthDescription: The notarized copy remained 60:40 from the beginning, and traces of consideration for a different ratio from the notarized copy can be seen in the separate handwritten will practice copy. Yoon Jeong-hoo remains responsible for tampering with the will, but it was not a manipulation to get more.
disputes.mediationLink: Relationship between notarized will and handwritten practice copy
disputes.judgmentStatement: The difference in the ratio of 60:40 between the notarized copy and the separate handwritten copy makes it possible to separate the responsibility for tampering with the will and the motive.

v3UnlockPlan.runtimeRule: In d-1, if a crack in the notarization process and mother's status is revealed, it will be lifted.
v3UnlockPlan.authoredRule: Have the notary public memo and handwritten practice copy separated and checked.
v3UnlockPlan.summary: Check the differences between the notarized copy of 60:40 itself and the separate handwritten practice copy.

verdictOptions.wrong: My younger brother manipulated the notarized copy to increase his share.
verdictOptions.partial: There is a difference between a notarized copy and a separate document, but motive and responsibility must be further confirmed.
verdictOptions.truth: The notarized copy was 60:40, and the exact ratio information can only be confirmed in the separate handwritten practice copy. Yoon Jeong-hoo's responsibility and the direction of his manipulation must be judged separately.
verdictOptions.defer: It is still difficult to determine the relationship between the notarized copy and the separate document. I reserve it.

disputes.name: Old sources of support
disputes.truthDescription: Yoon Jeong-hoo sent regular monthly support money to his mother's bank account, and also sent 300 million won through his mother's bank account during a crisis at his brother's factory. Yoon Tae-seong believed that the money was his mother's money.
disputes.mediationLink: Source and delivery order of support through mother's bank account
disputes.judgmentStatement: The key flow of support known as mother's money was that Yoon Jeong-hoo's money was delivered through his mother's bank account.

v3UnlockPlan.runtimeRule: The ban will be lifted if the details of the will change are revealed in d-2.
v3UnlockPlan.authoredRule: The background of the will ratio is confirmed by old account flows.
v3UnlockPlan.summary: Check the source and delivery order of the support that went through your mother’s bank account.

verdictOptions.wrong: My younger brother controlled my mother under the pretext of receiving regular support money.
verdictOptions.partial: Although the deposit flow is visible, only part of the source and purpose of delivery has been confirmed.
verdictOptions.truth: It is confirmed that Yoon Jeong-hoo's money was passed through his mother's bank account to Yoon Tae-seong.
verdictOptions.defer: It is difficult to determine the source and nature of account flows. I reserve it.

disputes.name: Family history and reasons for silence
disputes.truthDescription: There is a record in her mother's diary that Yoon Jeong-hu was her half-child, and that she felt more drawn to him as her identical child. Yoon Jeong-hoo remained silent for fear that this fact would bring down his brother.
disputes.judgmentStatement: There was a reason for Yoon Jeong-hoo's silence because he did not want to directly reveal sensitive circumstances in the family records to his brother.

v3UnlockPlan.runtimeRule: Unlocks when the source of old support is confirmed
v3UnlockPlan.authoredRule: The reason for hiding the source of the money continues through the mother's diary.
v3UnlockPlan.summary: Check the sensitive circumstances and reasons for silence in the family records.

verdictOptions.wrong: The younger brother tried to exclude his older brother from the inheritance by taking advantage of family circumstances.
verdictOptions.partial: Although it appears to be a sensitive family situation, the relationship with the will change needs to be further confirmed.
verdictOptions.truth: Due to family circumstances in his mother's diary, Yoon Jeong-hoo was unable to tell his brother straight away, and his silence was linked to the motive for changing the will.
verdictOptions.defer: It is difficult to determine the relationship between family records and silence. I reserve it.

disputes.name: mother's hidden heart
disputes.truthDescription: Yoon Tae-seong took the inheritance for granted as a reward for caring, and Yoon Jeong-hu tried to organize his mother's will and documents on his behalf for the sake of protecting his older brother. Neither of them could leave their mother's will as is.
disputes.mediationLink: Mother's Will and Two Sons' Responsibilities
disputes.judgmentStatement: The two brothers implemented their mother's wishes according to their own standards in different ways.

v3UnlockPlan.runtimeRule: Unlocked when both d-3 and d-4 are sufficiently revealed.
v3UnlockPlan.authoredRule: After all old support and family records are revealed, the final accountability structure opens up.
v3UnlockPlan.summary: Compare the final responsibility for who carried out the mother's will and how.

verdictOptions.wrong: My younger brother tried to monopolize the inheritance by using my mother.
verdictOptions.partial: Both had problems in their relationship with their mothers.
verdictOptions.truth: Yoon Tae-seong took the inheritance for granted, and Yoon Jeong-hu tried to rewrite his mother's will, saying he was protecting his older brother. Neither of them could leave their mother's will as is.
verdictOptions.defer: It is difficult to judge the mother's hidden feelings. I reserve it.

truthTable.fact: Although her mother did not completely lose her ability to make decisions in her later years, Yun Jeong-hoo's intervention influenced the writing of her will.

The notarized copy was 60:40, and the exact ratio, which is different from the notarized copy, can be confirmed in the separate handwritten copy of the will. Yoon Jeong-hoo tampered with the will, but it was not a manipulation to get more.
Yoon Jeong-hoo's money went into his mother's bank account on a monthly basis, and during the factory crisis, 300 million won was also transferred through the same route.
The mother's diary leaves behind the fact that Yoon Jeong-hoo was her half-child, and the nuance that she cared for him even more as her own child.
Neither of them could leave their mother's will as is. Yoon Tae-seong took the inheritance for granted, and Yoon Jeong-hu changed the will to protect his older brother.

유서적법성판단: The judgment ability of the mother with dementia at the time of writing the will is confirmed through professional appraisal, and the legality of the notarization process is re-evaluated.
Although Yoon Jeong-hoo's act of manipulating his will is illegal, the legal effect of the separate handwritten practice copy will be reviewed taking into account the motive.
재산분배재조정: Compare the legal effect of 60:40 handwritten practice copy and notarized copy, and recalculate fair distribution taking into account old support history.
The 300 million won that Yoon Jeong-hoo put into his mother's bank account and was transferred to Yoon Tae-seong's factory funds is subject to separate settlement.
가족관계회복: The scope of disclosure of birth secrets is determined with the consent of the parties, and coordination procedures are established to restore sibling relationships.

recipes.discoveryText: The 60:40 ratio in the will overlaps with the visit records from later years. It is necessary to check again whether Yoon Jeong-hoo was present during the process of writing the will.

My brother's words, 'I'm the one who took care of him' and the record in my mother's diary conflict. We need to figure out how each of them wrote down their mother's will.
Combining the older brother's words, 'I'm the one who took care of him' and the old account flow, we can see the younger brother's motivation for taking on both money and silence.
The increase in nursing home visit records overlaps with the time when all nursing care workers read the paper.

officialRecordRecommendations: Although my mother did not completely lose her ability to make judgments in her later years, there was Yoon Jeong-hoo's intervention.
The 60:40 will is the result of Yoon Jeong-hoo's manipulation of reducing his share of the proportion of separate handwritten practice books.

Yoon Jeong-hoo had been sending regular support funds to his mother for a long time, and during Yoon Tae-seong's factory crisis, he put 300 million won into his mother's bank account and had it delivered to Yoon Tae-seong.
Yoon Tae-seong is not his father's biological son, and Yoon Jeong-hu knew this and fabricated a will to protect his older brother.
Neither of them could leave their mother as she was. Yoon Tae-seong took the inheritance for granted, and Yoon Jeong-hu tried to protect his older brother by changing his mother's will.
